text.text_excerpt: Really great snoballs! Since SnoWizard has not been good this year, we decided to try Imperial Woodpecker. Their ice is almost Hansen's fine and they have some really good homemade flavors like Watermelon-Jalapeño, Lime-Basil, Strawberry-Basil, etc. I love cream flavors and have tried Cream of Ice Cream, Cream of Wedding Cake, and Cream of Chocolate. Sooo good! I love to get it topped with condensed milk and they do not skimp, the girl who made mine last time even put some in the middle :) Service is a bit slow because sometimes there is only one person working, but they are super nice. It is a tad more expensive (~$1 more per snoball) than other snoball stands, but the quality is worth t...

I've had Imperial at events around the city over the years, but yesterday was the first time I stopped by their brick and mortar! While it looked a wee bit busy, my sister and I were able to put in our orders quickly. They have the flavors you know and love (Orchid Cream Vanilla is my go-to at most stands), but they also have these great unique flavors like Grapefruit Basil which is what I ordered and my sister ordered the Coconut Milk. They have a kid size for $2.50 that is the PERFECT size for me, since I'm not a huge sweets person. It is a $1 extra for the really unique flavors, but I'm totally okay with that. Love this place ! We came back twice because the ice is made fresh and the flavors have a homemade touch to them which does not make them taste artificial at all. Compared to another place, this place does not drench your ice so after eating your way down, you're left with some cool leftover ice to refresh your palate instead of a sugary, syrupy mess. We tried their Nectar cream, root beer, grapefruit basil, and earl grey cream. The nectar cream and grapefruit basil (the latter being their homemade flavor) were so refreshing together. The earl grey cream (also homemade) paired with root beer worked really well like a fancy root beer float ! Yum !
